notes.title: Jawbreaker: Update #1 (New Character + Items + Achievements + Alternate Ending)
notes.content:
The first big update for Jawbreaker has been launched with a some new goodies:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42921845/9489faf4f4795cd09e11865f7d236a0bb6b5cb1a.jpg
New Character: Fox
You're no longer alone, an unknown professional named 'Fox' is just steps ahead of you. He will lead you to new items, hints, and areas...but only if you have a sharp enough eye to find the clues.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42921845/9ec7912f2a53336b1eb67e77c8145b568c5a8fa1.jpg
New Item: Decryptors
A new item has entered Jawbreaker, the Decryptors. These strange pre-collapse devices are extremely rare and allow access into government terminals and buildings. Though much like the character leaving them around: They are hidden from plain sight and require clever exploration.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42921845/01b9a3a42f93f2085a70569bd0e2d5d9c252d3d0.jpg
New Ending & Alternate Path: The Insider
A new ending is now accessible through an alternate path in the later parts of the game. This new ending is the official ending of the game (the original ending "The Hard Road" is now the games alternate 'B' ending). 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42921845/0ebf228012c989c7c8f003284b8dc17d4f41703f.jpg
Achievements:
There's 5 new achievements related to Fox's storyline.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42921845/5320af6990e97853a3e20122b413fa50fabd5ebb.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42921845/43754a834abd85bb247dbf5f1978c8574277a186.jpg
And more...
There's a full assortment of modifications, bug fixes, and additions to the game that you'll have to find for yourself! (Modifications to Enemy AI, Improved Gamepad Support, and other such changes).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42921845/1de68a0fb79bfa6c5a488d778e64fc71e32b8a95.jpg

Thanks to everyone being patient with the updates and fixes! I'm continuing to incorporate feedback into updates and patches to make Jawbreaker the best stealth + survival horror it can be.

VL
@VincentLade

notes.title: Jawbreaker Launched + Patch 1.0!
notes.content:
Jawbreaker has been launched for all to play on Steam! Come enter a world of criminal survival horror:

[previewyoutube=30JmgVzX13U;full][/previewyoutube]
It's been less than 24 hours since the launch and after hearing your initial feedback I have already released a patch to fix + modify some things players have pointed out:

Enemy AI
I've heard that the enemies are too difficult, the original concept was that they have the same attributes as the player to make it more realistic and punishing. After some feedback I've decreased their detection and stamina: 

Enemy 'Field Of View (FOV)' decreased by 30%
Enemy 'Sight Range' decreased by 30%
Enemy 'Chase Time' decreased by 30%

Boss Health
Some early players noticed a bug where if you injure one of the bosses and die, the bosses health doesn't reset back to 100 after the level restarts:

Boss health bug has been fixed on all levels (a good catch, though now the bosses are harder hah)

Mini Boss: Darktooth
Some edits to the level "Darktooth's Lair" that makes evading or fighting the mini boss 'Darktooth' more manageable: 

Darktooth's 'Field Of View (FOV)' decreased
Darktooth's 'Sight Range' decreased
Lighter item has more range
Additional lights added in key areas

Misc
Assorted fixes spotted by keen players:

Missing floor panel collider on "The Arena" fixed
Missing animation from "Spider's Web" fixed
Missing animation from "Crash Pad" fixed
UI fix for menu selection with gamepad on Main Menu
UI for Item Shortcuts improved

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42921845/a798bdcb9deb4c4d260fba48dfee9c554c972c40.png
(Level: The Jump)

On another note: I've been seeing players struggle on "The Jump", the first stealth part of the game with 3 gang members. 

This level is intentionally difficult for 2 reasons: You don't have any weapons yet and it's intentionally punishing if you don't use stealth, this is to let the player know you can't just run or shoot your way through every situation. 

If you're struggling with this level try to get through it as you get the Sawn-Off Shotgun in the next level and enemy patrols are less difficult afterwards, just wanted to point out that the game 'punches you in the face' straight away, but then gets more tame! So please stick with sneaking through that level using the Radar, Vision Item, peaking around corners, etc. as I'm sure you'll enjoy everything in the game past that point 

Please don't negatively review the game because of the difficulty! It's a hard game and I'm patching it to be more forgiving to find the right balance. To reiterate: "The Jump" is the 7th level and it's a lesson in stealth, but it's 100% worth beating to continue your journey

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42921845/9144b2faf9f58bbf903d5a648981f99778c834cd.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42921845/ca103ff377c9720cf12d7c08ec6e8335043ce180.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42921845/99253fde9ebbce08e1ee0aadb9499e66411d0e5f.png

I'll be continuously updating the game so don't forget to leave your feedback!

VL
@VincentLade

notes.title: Jawbreaker: Releasing April 23rd!
notes.content:
Jawbreaker is almost here! The launch of the full game will on April 23rd at 2:00pm(CST)!

In only 3 weeks you'll be able to enter a survival horror game that will have you running, hiding, and fighting in a terrifying gang-infested society on the verge of collapse. Though that’s not all, once the sun goes down the true fear begins...

[previewyoutube=30JmgVzX13U;full][/previewyoutube]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42921845/02f5ce392f2062f0756ac26b0b3ec83b5f883cb7.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42921845/adb14a30218f2c29bef848b3a226956e4491a9f9.png
After the devastating "Great Economic Collapse of 2028," survival is the only thing that matters. The average person is compelled to join armed groups, engaging in battles for resources and control over what were once the cities and towns of the United States.

You belong to a small gang based in New Citadel City, and your bunker's supplies are dwindling. You've been chosen to venture into the concrete ruins on rumours of an unlooted police station on the edge of town—a high-risk, high-reward mission.

After breaking in through an unguarded entrance, a sense of dread fills your mind as you realise who has taken refuge in this station and question whether the entire thing was a setup by your own gang…

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42921845/ca103ff377c9720cf12d7c08ec6e8335043ce180.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42921845/99253fde9ebbce08e1ee0aadb9499e66411d0e5f.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42921845/54b645a12b5b50d30bf31767967ce275b2021ea8.png

 Run, hide, or kill those in your way to stay breathing
 The “Faceless Gang” will hunt you in teams or on their own
 Push through the station while scavenging for supplies and a way to escape
 Once the sun goes down the real danger begins…


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42921845/9396381fd215f0c942da130c5ec6508e906fdcd9.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42921845/7c51480563ad2994cb7ae02062e45f928f79da20.jpg


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42921845/b31c6e68bfebb3641002146ddcb9927bfeb78534.png

 Deep exploration into a dystopian vision of the United States
 Hide under tables, in lockers, between shelves, or shadows to stay unseen
 Search for weapons to defend yourself, though gunshots draw attention...
 An interactive environment encourages looting for supplies
 Multiple endings prove if you are a true survivor or not


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42921845/809bb0a4265dab757d24d3cfafb2c31ba556a484.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42921845/46d906f39244cf8f8e54265116620474bfa5cdfa.png

Genre: Survival horror with stealth, puzzle, and combat mechanics.

Demo available now

notes.title: Jawbreaker: Updated Trailer + New Boss!
notes.content:
Jawbreaker has some big updates! The new trailer reveals 2 epic boss battles, a menacing mini-boss, brand new locations, and a new weapon:

[previewyoutube=30JmgVzX13U;full][/previewyoutube]

Prepare to face the "Faceless Speaker" boss in Jawbreaker. This nightmare-fueled foe boasts three intense attack phases:

 Conveyer Belts / Saws / Machine Guns
 Rocket barrages
 Flamethrowers

Luckily it's prone to overheating, afterwards you can break open one of five wall panels. Inside, you'll find the lever for two maintenance hatches with fuel tanks. Blast away all 10 tanks to destroy the machine completely.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42921845/ca103ff377c9720cf12d7c08ec6e8335043ce180.png

A truly chaotic boss fight that will have players on their toes the entire duration.

Along with the new boss fight there's new areas to explore in Jawbreaker, such as: The Faceless Bunker, Underground Parking, IT (a cryptic puzzle-filled zone), Darktooth's Lair (home to a challenging mini-boss), and new areas of the New Citadel Police Station.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42921845/5d09b917b610cef9243bfbb6fff865a5d0aa3a11.png
The entrance to "The Faceless Bunker"

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42921845/46d906f39244cf8f8e54265116620474bfa5cdfa.png
Encountering Darktooth in "IT"

The demo has received an update too. Some extra features, fixes, and a couple hidden Easter Eggs have been added.

VL
@VincentLade

notes.title: Jawbreaker demo has launched!
notes.content:
The playable demo for the stealth-horror game "Jawbreaker" is now available for download on Steam! (and soon Itchio). Enter a collapsed society where gangs rule and looting is the only way to stay alive...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42921845/a488996d315039745dadfe56ccedcc97ecd9d9a0.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42921845/8165ba343965296885590a62de12063c9bc2aade.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42921845/ff7ce07f64ea786cc5179795970aef0246340559.png

The Story:

In this anarchistic city there’s one rule everyone must follow: Hide before sundown. Though supplies are running low in your shelter, so you venture into the fray to hunt for something to bring back. During this search an untouched police station catches your eye, an unusual sight in a heavily looted neighbourhood. You take the risk and break-in through an unsecured door, shortly after dread begins to set in as you realise who has taken refuge in this station, and why no other scavengers dare to enter it.

The Demo:

Takes place in a segment called "The Break-In" which is after "The Streets of New Citadel City" and before the main events of the story. Explore NCPD and 4 of its goon infested levels as you scavenge, track, hide, fight, and run to stay alive.

notes.title: "Jawbreaker" is in development!
notes.content:
Let’s play hide-and-seek with serial killers.

Jawbreaker is a psychological horror game that will have you running, hiding, and fighting to survive a terrifying gang-infested society on the verge of collapse. Though that’s not all, once the sun goes down the true fear will begin...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42921845/a63bfc14b3a0ddbab0875ac65ee2523a83b1277b.png

My latest game called "Jawbreaker" will dive deep into psychological horror and include features like stealth, puzzles, and combat. Despite the Steam and IndieDB pages being just launched, the game is already deep in development and has been worked on since the completion of my last game "Witching Hour".

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42921845/2669e5c6e7069b1c27eabb086c1685a0642f8018.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42921845/4c60f275fbc2272a83884b1511f344de41f8f70b.png

The Story

In this anarchistic city there’s one rule everyone must follow: Hide before sundown. Though supplies are running low in your shelter, so you venture into the fray to hunt for something to bring back. During this search an untouched police station catches your eye, an unusual sight in a heavily looted neighbourhood. You take the risk and break-in through an unsecured door, shortly after dread begins to set in as you realise who has taken refuge in this station, and why no other scavengers dare to enter it.

Survive At All Costs

 Run, hide, or kill those in your way to stay breathing
 The “Faceless Gang” will hunt you in teams or on their own
 Push through the station while scavenging for supplies and a way to escape
 Once the sun goes down the real danger begins…

 Deep exploration into a dystopian vision of the United States
 Hide under tables, in lockers, between shelves, or shadows to stay unseen
